bead.title: Separate listener bind config from Kafka bootstrap config
bead.description: PROBLEM: the sink endpoint is doing two jobs, so the server cannot express a listener bind address and an external Kafka bootstrap address independently. ROOT CAUSE: `crates/pqueue-server/src/config.rs:41` conflates `fjord.listen` with producer bootstrap selection and accepts schemeless `host:port` values that are silently treated as Kafka. PROPOSED FIX: add distinct `fjord.listen` and `kafka.bootstrap` settings, require an explicit `kafka://` scheme for Kafka bootstrap, and keep listener parsing/binding separate from producer bootstrap selection. NON-SCOPE: topic encoding, wire-format serialization, batching changes, startup sleep cleanup.
bead.acceptance:
1. `TestConfigSeparatesListenFromKafkaBootstrap` proves the listener bind address and Kafka bootstrap address can be configured independently.
2. `TestConfigRejectsSchemalessKafkaBootstrap` rejects schemeless `host:port` bootstrap values and accepts explicit `kafka://` bootstrap values.
3. `TestConfigKeepsListenerDefaultsWhenBootstrapChanges` confirms listener defaults remain unchanged when only Kafka bootstrap changes.
4. `go test ./crates/pqueue-server/...` passes for config parsing and validation.
5. `lefthook run pre-commit` passes with the config split and tests.
